question: Who Owns CAVA?
quick_answer: CAVA is an independent, publicly traded company listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CAVA, so it is owned by its shareholders. It started as a Mediterranean restaurant founded by friends in the Washington, D.C. area, grew as a fast-casual brand, acquired Zoes Kitchen in 2018, and went public in 2023.
key_facts: Publicly traded on the NYSE under ticker CAVA
Started as a Mediterranean restaurant in the Washington, D.C. area

body.heading: Who owns CAVA?
body.text: CAVA is a public company, owned collectively by its shareholders. It trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CAVA and is run by its own management and board, rather than being owned by a larger parent company.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: CAVA began as a Mediterranean restaurant founded by a group of friends in the Washington, D.C. area. It grew into a fast-casual chain built around customizable Mediterranean bowls and pitas, with fresh ingredients, dips and spreads.

body.heading: Growth and going public
body.text: CAVA acquired the Mediterranean chain Zoes Kitchen in 2018, which helped it expand quickly by converting locations. In 2023 it held its initial public offering, becoming a publicly traded company owned by its shareholders.
